metformin.reason: Risk of lactic acidosis; contraindicated if eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73m²

digoxin.reason: Narrow therapeutic index; renally cleared — toxic accumulation at reduced GFR

lithium.reason: Exclusively renally excreted; high risk of toxicity with impaired clearance

spironolactone.reason: Risk of life-threatening hyperkalaemia; avoid if eGFR <30

NSAIDs.reason: Inhibit prostaglandin-mediated renal perfusion; can precipitate acute kidney injury

codeine.reason: Active metabolite morphine-6-glucuronide accumulates; risk of respiratory depression

warfarin.reason: Altered protein binding in uraemia; INR monitoring frequency should increase

simvastatin.reason: Increased myopathy risk with reduced renal clearance of active metabolites

warfarin.reason: Severely impaired synthesis of clotting factors amplifies anticoagulant effect

methotrexate.reason: Extensively hepatically metabolised; severe hepatotoxicity risk

amiodarone.reason: Hepatotoxic; markedly elevated exposure in hepatic failure

statins.reason: Primarily hepatically metabolised; impaired clearance raises hepatotoxicity and myopathy risk

acetaminophen.reason: Depleted glutathione reserves in liver disease increase NAPQI toxicity risk

sertraline.reason: Hepatic metabolism impaired; use half dose and monitor for serotonergic toxicity

diazepam.reason: Prolonged half-life; risk of encephalopathy — prefer lorazepam or oxazepam

simvastatin.reason: Active site hepatic uptake impaired; elevated systemic exposure and hepatotoxicity risk

NSAIDs.reason: Sodium and water retention worsens fluid overload; blunts efficacy of diuretics

verapamil.reason: Negative inotrope; can precipitate acute decompensation in reduced-EF heart failure

diltiazem.reason: Negative inotrope; contraindicated in HFrEF — worsens cardiac output

thiazolidinediones.reason: Cause fluid retention and peripheral oedema; worsen heart failure status

amiodarone.reason: Thyroid and pulmonary toxicity; negative chronotropy — monitor closely in HF

metformin.reason: Previously cautioned in unstable HF due to lactic acidosis risk; avoid if haemodynamically compromised

digoxin.reason: Narrow therapeutic index; hypokalaemia from diuretics increases toxicity risk

warfarin.reason: Hepatic congestion in severe HF reduces clotting factor synthesis; INR may fluctuate

corticosteroids.reason: Potent hyperglycaemic effect; often requires insulin dose escalation

thiazide_diuretics.reason: Mild glucose intolerance and hypokalaemia; monitor HbA1c

beta_blockers.reason: Mask hypoglycaemia symptoms (tachycardia suppressed); prolonged hypoglycaemia risk

fluoroquinolones.reason: Associated with both hypoglycaemia and hyperglycaemia; monitor blood glucose closely

metformin.reason: First-line but requires eGFR monitoring; combination with renal impairment is high risk

statins.reason: Modest increase in new-onset diabetes risk; benefit-risk ratio still favourable in most patients

codeine.reason: Opioid-induced nausea and appetite disruption may destabilise glycaemic control

NSAIDs.reason: Sodium retention and vasoconstriction raise blood pressure; blunt antihypertensive therapy

decongestants.reason: Sympathomimetic effect (pseudoephedrine) causes acute blood pressure elevation

venlafaxine.reason: Dose-dependent noradrenaline reuptake inhibition raises systolic BP; monitor at higher doses

oral_contraceptives.reason: Oestrogen component promotes renin-angiotensin activation; can increase BP by 3–5 mmHg

amiodarone.reason: Peripheral vasodilation may cause hypotension; unpredictable BP effect in polypharmacy

ciclosporin.reason: Causes vasoconstriction and sodium retention; a major cause of drug-induced hypertension
